recommendation: Introduce one internal OriginalSourcePlan for already admitted bounded original groups and a single serializer whose exact escaped output is both priced and emitted. Keep query interpretation, SQL candidate acquisition, custody lifecycle and eligibility unchanged for this first change.
minimum_design: Input: guarded source intervals, complete atomic executions, provenance qualifiers, and separately typed derived associations. Preserve existing priority policy initially; do not replace relevance with a project transcript.

Use an explicit immutable semantic qualifier key. Share container metadata only when project/worktree/environment/version, session applicability, source role, custody disposition, meaning, uncertainty and historical/current context are identical. Missing, unknown and explicit values are distinct.

Serialize each quotation once per compatible source identity and qualifier context; use explicit references from separately qualified associations. A displayed quotation does not establish that an associated claim is true, current or belongs to the same task.

Remove redundant outer item IDs only for purely synthetic display containers without incoming identity references. Keep canonical claim/episode/revision identifiers when they carry association or state meaning.

Compute complete escaped XML, wrappers, separators, association references and omission markers with the same serializer used for final output. Apply per-owner and total budgets; reserve marker/root closing costs before admission.
cannot_safely_drop: Every citable source must retain source_id, source_role, source_field, start, end and a direct quote_excerpt child. Frozen helper reader_citation_catalog iterates source elements and does not inherit pointer attributes from containers.
Execution command, full output, exit status, tool identity/tool_use_id and their original provenance remain one atomic group. Unknown capture types must not acquire observed-execution status.
Scope, uncertainty, custody disposition, historical status, relationship-not-assessed and capture-order-not-event-time qualifiers cannot be discarded merely because quotation text matches.

Same-text different events or roles are not duplicates. Same-source different fields are not interchangeable citations: removing a body/output mirror can change the frozen catalog. Preserve catalog parity or explicitly reject the optimization until compatibility is resolved.

An association reference to an omitted original must be marked unresolved/unshown and cannot claim grounded displayed evidence. Omission counts must distinguish acquisition limits, unfit original groups and omitted associations.
contract_tests: Snapshot admitted candidate identities and hard-guard results before/after for project, exact task/ID/version, environment, session exclusion, privacy, deletion and historical/as-of queries; no newly eligible sources.

Frozen helper catalog equality for identical semantics before/after, including quoted XML characters, non-ASCII text, same-source distinct fields, differing roles, overlapping intervals, same-text different events and conflicting qualifiers.

Both ordering permutations for same quote with different custody/history/scope/uncertainty; compacted neutral observations must not imply current requirement, cancellation, closure or same-task identity.
Exact-fit and one-character-below cases for root, container, tool group and omission marker; tiny budgets and multi-project split must remain bounded with no partial execution or malformed XML.

Two derived associations sharing an original: quote is charged once, both independently qualified relationships retained or explicitly omitted. No dangling grounded references when quote or association cannot fit.
Read-only Store invariance and bounded query/source counts; no added model calls, state writes, body scans or candidate-limit expansion.
evidence_limits: The diagnostic reports 438274 markup characters out of 539129 saved XML characters, about 81.3 percent. This is not achievable savings: citation identity, semantic qualifiers and structural overhead remain necessary.

Its hypothetical full inventory fits only 27 of 108 owner parts; 81 exceed budget before missing qualifiers are added. It is not the actual eligible candidate universe and cannot establish all-source completeness.
No grades or answers were read for this assessment. No replay queries, Store operations or models were run.
No implementation or quality clearance. Fresh independent evaluation remains required after reviewed implementation; known-source transport gains are diagnostic only.
